$description: Accrue brand tokens, version 2.0. Neutral names; map them to your own system. Product-only values (radius, elevation, layers, UI motion) are not brand tokens and live with the product.

ledger-paper.$description: The background: warm, never white. Pages, docs, the README banner. About 60% of a light surface.

ledger-green.$description: The wordmark, all text, buttons and code. A deep bottle green, never black. About 22% of a light surface.

folio.$description: Raised surfaces: cards, code blocks, Accrue Admin’s panels. About 10% of a light surface.

line-green.$description: The double line and graphics only. At 3.6:1 contrast, never small text. About 4% of a light surface.

column-line.$description: Hairlines and table lines: the lines of a ledger. About 4% of a light surface.

ledger-green.$description: The background in dark mode, on the cover, talks and the social card. About 62% of a dark surface.

ledger-paper.$description: The wordmark and all text: 10.9:1. About 22% of a dark surface.

felt.$description: Raised surfaces: cards, code blocks, the docs sidebar. About 10% of a dark surface.

mint-line.$description: The double line, links and buttons on dark: 6.8:1. About 6% of a dark surface.

pencil.$description: Secondary text on Ledger Paper and Folio.

sage.$description: Secondary text on Ledger Green and Felt.

light.$description: Done, in Stripe’s or Braintree’s own words: paid, refunded, active. Shown with the Paid mark, a small double line, beside the word. Paid Ink on light, Mint Line on dark.

dark.$description: Done, in Stripe’s or Braintree’s own words: paid, refunded, active. Shown with the Paid mark, a small double line, beside the word. Paid Ink on light, Mint Line on dark.

light.$description: A charge or refund sent to Stripe or Braintree that they haven’t confirmed yet, or a webhook received and not yet applied. Brass Ink on light, Brass on dark.

dark.$description: A charge or refund sent to Stripe or Braintree that they haven’t confirmed yet, or a webhook received and not yet applied. Brass Ink on light, Brass on dark.

light.$description: Refused or failed, by Stripe, Braintree or Accrue. Red Ink on light, a lighter red on dark. Bookkeepers’ red, used sparingly.

dark.$description: Refused or failed, by Stripe, Braintree or Accrue. Red Ink on light, a lighter red on dark. Bookkeepers’ red, used sparingly.

light.$description: Stripe hasn’t sent anything yet, or its last update is old. Pencil on light, Sage on dark, never green or red, because Accrue doesn’t guess.

dark.$description: Stripe hasn’t sent anything yet, or its last update is old. Pencil on light, Sage on dark, never green or red, because Accrue doesn’t guess.

light.$description: Names, operators and punctuation. Keywords and module names are the same color in weight 600.

dark.$description: Names, operators and punctuation. Keywords and module names are the same color in weight 600.

light.$description: Strings and string interpolation, in a muted plum: away from green, brass and red.

dark.$description: Strings and string interpolation, in a muted plum: away from green, brass and red.

light.$description: Atoms, keyword keys and numbers: in a cool slate.

dark.$description: Atoms, keyword keys and numbers: in a cool slate.

serif.$description: 600 for the name, headlines and titles; 400 italic for quotes and the voice line

sans.$description: 400 for reading, 500 for leads, 600 for emphasis and labels

mono.$description: 400 for code, IDs and figures; 500 for a total

motion.$description: Brand character reference, not a UI spec: the only values the logo animation and the Paid mark use.

logo-close.$description: From start to rest: the word fades in by 180 ms, line 1 draws 240 to 620 ms, line 2 660 to 960 ms.

pen-ease.$description: Each line: slow in, quickest in the middle, slow into its end.

confirm.$description: The Paid mark, a small double line, drawn in beside the word as a value becomes paid, on the pen ease.
